workflow_runs.display_title: feat(deps)!: link the versioned project and document cache

head_commit.message:
feat(deps)!: link onetaskgraph 0.7.0, the store that caches project and document reads

Move the whole onetaskgraph family (core, plugin-api, local-md and the
transitive github-projects, linear, in-memory) to 0.7.0 in one step, and the
installed template-journey binary with it. The plugin API's public Project,
Document and VersionCoverage gain members, so the link is breaking.

GitHub change tokens move from gh2 to gh3; a task version recorded before
the move costs one more read and is never served from cache. The engine
keeps versions opaque and adds no translation or engine-side cache.

The cache-enabled GitHub store journey now also reads one project through
`plan check` twice and compares its report and board queries with the cache
on and off.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
